task.title: Split artifact_state and deployment_stage in registry contracts
task.summary_zh: 把 registry 與 promotion contract 裡的 artifact_state 和 deployment_stage 正式拆開，避免批准語意和部署語意混在一起。
task.next: REG-004 finalized after Qwen approval. Registry contract, entry schema, and promotion docs now treat artifact_state as canonical governance lifecycle and deployment_stage as separate derived deployment/runtime semantics. Compatibility window for legacy lifecycle_state/promotion_state consumers remains explicitly documented for downstream migration tasks.

handoffs.message: Contract-first REG-004 cutover is ready for review. Updated services/registry/contract.md and services/registry/registry_entry_schema.json to use artifact_state=draft/candidate/approved/retired, moved deployment_stage ownership into deployment/runtime semantics, and added derived deployment_summary guidance. Updated services/registry/promotion/README.md to describe approved-state governance versus paper/canary/live deployment stages, with explicit legacy compatibility notes for gate.py/loader consumers. Added compatibility notes to services/registry/lineage/contract.md and services/execution/artifact-loader/contract.md. Verification: python3 -m json.tool services/registry/registry_entry_schema.json.
